2026-11-26.title: Daddy's Home

2026-11-26.title: The Interview

His best and only friend Blaise is accused in his place and sentenced to 7 years in a psychiatric hospital. At the day of his release, Blaise realizes he only has one family: his best friend George. But he does not want to hear about his childhood friend, as he tries to integrate with the “Chivers” a gang whose members wear red jackets and boots, drink milk, drive sport trucks and play an incomprehensible and violent game that mixes cricket and mental arithmetic.

2026-11-26.title: Horrible Bosses
2026-11-26.overview: For Nick, Kurt and Dale, the only thing that would make the daily grind more tolerable would be to grind their intolerable bosses into dust. Quitting is not an option, so, with the benefit of a few-too-many drinks and some dubious advice from a hustling ex-con, the three friends devise a convoluted and seemingly foolproof plan to rid themselves of their respective employers... permanently.

2026-11-26.title: Safety Not Guaranteed
2026-11-26.overview: Three magazine employees head out on an assignment to interview a guy who placed a classified ad seeking a companion for time travel.

2026-11-26.title: The Blues Brothers
2026-11-26.overview: Just released from prison, Jake Blues puts his old band back together with his brother Elwood to save the Catholic home where they were raised.

2026-11-26.title: The Nice Guys
2026-11-26.overview: A private eye investigates the apparent suicide of a fading porn star in 1970s Los Angeles and uncovers a conspiracy.

2026-11-26.title: Mean Girls

2026-11-26.title: American Pie 2

As it turns out, whether that will happen or not has a lot to do with the girls. 2026-11-26.title: Friday

2026-11-26.title: Back to the Future Part II

2026-11-26.title: Money Talks

2026-11-26.title: This Is the End

2026-11-26.title: O Brother, Where Art Thou?

2026-11-26.title: Tommy Boy

As the evening transitions from the restaurant to the bedroom, the two men go on a madcap search for what will surely make the night complete: condoms.

But the pair must change their plans when Kumar is accused of being a terrorist. Rob Corddry also stars in this wild comedy sequel that follows the hapless stoners' misadventures as they try to avoid being captured by the Department of Homeland Security.

2026-11-27.title: 30 Minutes or Less
2026-11-27.overview: Two fledgling criminals kidnap a pizza delivery guy, strap a bomb to his chest, and advise him that he has mere hours to rob a bank or else...

2026-11-27.title: Dumb and Dumber
2026-11-27.overview: Lloyd and Harry are two men whose stupidity is really indescribable. When Mary, a beautiful woman, loses an important suitcase with money before she leaves for Aspen, the two friends (who have found the suitcase) decide to return it to her. After some "adventures" they finally get to Aspen where, using the lost money they live it up and fight for Mary's heart.

When he arrives with his leather-clad girlfriend to try his first case, it's a real shock - for him and the Deep South!

2026-11-27.title: The Waterboy
2026-11-27.overview: Bobby Boucher is a water boy for a struggling college football team. The coach discovers Boucher's hidden rage makes him a tackling machine whose bone-crushing power might vault his team into the playoffs.

2026-11-27.title: Hail, Caesar!

To hook up with her, Noah takes to the streets, but his urban adventure spins out of control as he finds himself on the run from a maniacal drug lord.

2026-11-27.title: Identity Thief

2026-11-27.title: The Other Guys

When a seemingly minor case turns out to be a big deal, the two cops get the opportunity to finally prove to their comrades that they have the right stuff.

2026-11-27.title: Meet the Parents

2026-11-27.title: Seeking a Friend for the End of the World

2026-11-27.overview: The characters we met a little more than a decade ago return to East Great Falls for their high school reunion. In one long-overdue weekend, they will discover what has changed, who hasn’t, and that time and distance can’t break the bonds of friendship.

2026-11-27.title: All About the Benjamins

Bucum and Reggie find themselves in a race to the finish as they embark on an unlikely partnership that should -- when all is said and done -- prove beneficial to them both.

2026-11-27.title: 50 First Dates
2026-11-27.overview: Henry is a player skilled at seducing women. That's because the delightful Lucy has no short-term memory, so Henry must woo her day after day until he finally sweeps her off her feet.

2026-11-27.title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.

Enter, Jacob Palmer, a self-styled player who takes Cal under his wing and teaches him how to be a hit with the ladies.

2026-11-28.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective

He goes eyeball to eyeball with a man-eating shark, stakes out the Miami Dolphins and woos and wows the ladies. Whether he's undercover, under fire or underwater, he always gets his man… or beast!

2026-11-28.title: That's My Boy
2026-11-28.overview: While in his teens, Donny fathered a son, Todd, and raised him as a single parent up until Todd's 18th birthday. Now, after not seeing each other for years, Todd's world comes crashing down when Donny resurfaces just before Todd's wedding.

2026-11-28.title: Orange County

2026-11-28.title: Borat: Cultural Learnings of America for Make Benefit Glorious Nation of Kazakhstan

2026-11-28.title: Half Baked
2026-11-28.overview: Three lovable party buds try to bail their friend out of jail. But just when the guys have mastered a plan, everything comes dangerously close to going up in smoke.

Somehow, the boys manage to run afoul of rednecks, cops and even a car-stealing Neil Patrick Harris before getting anywhere near their beloved sliders.

2026-11-28.overview: A calamity at Dante and Randall's shops sends them looking for new horizons - but they ultimately settle at Mooby's, a fictional Disney-McDonald's-style fast-food empire.

The new partners must overcome their differences to solve an important case with help from street informant Huggy Bear and persuasive criminal Reese Feldman.

2026-11-28.title: Dumb and Dumber To

2026-11-28.title: A Christmas Story

2026-11-28.title: Tommy Boy
2026-11-28.overview: To save the family business, two ne’er-do-well traveling salesmen hit the road with disastrously funny consequences.

2026-11-28.title: Wrong Cops

2026-11-28.title: The Incredible Burt Wonderstone
2026-11-28.overview: After breaking up with his longtime stage partner, a famous but jaded Vegas magician fights for relevance when a new, "hip" street magician appears on the scene.
